info.title: Indox DRF converters
info.description: DRF-mounted convert/media routes for SDK OpenAPI merge

get.description: Return details for a stored conversion.

post.description:
Upload an image file (multipart/form-data) OR provide a remote reference. Send exactly one of: 'file' or ('file_url' or 's3_key').

- file_url: a public or pre-signed URL the worker can GET.
- s3_key: S3 object key in your bucket (worker downloads via IAM).
When hiding, the service will delete any stored output and the original S3 object if 's3_key' was provided.

get.description: Stream a batch ZIP file containing multiple conversions without exposing the S3 URL.

404.description: Batch not found or ZIP unavailable

post.description:
Create a ZIP for a set of conversions (and/or batches) and return one link.

POST /api/v1/media_core/batch/collect/
Body: { "ids": ["<conversion_or_batch_id>", ...] }
- Expands any batch IDs into their items
- Requires all items be the same category (image or video)
- Creates a new ConversionBatch and enqueues a zipper job
- Returns 202 with { batch_id, status, download_url }
post.summary: Collect multiple items into one ZIP

202.description: Batch accepted; ZIP will be prepared.

get.description: Pass either a single conversion ID (image/video) or a batch ID. Returns a masked `download_url` when ready.

ConversionID.description: Resolve a single conversion to one download URL

BatchID.description: Resolve a batch (zip) to one download URL

get.description: Blocks up to `timeout` seconds waiting for the conversion (image/video) or batch ZIP to finish. Returns 200 with `completed=true` and a masked `download_url` if done, or 202 with `completed=false` if still processing. Pass either a conversion id (int/uuid) or a batch id (uuid).
get.summary: Wait for conversion or batch completion

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Seconds to wait before returning (default 30, max 120)

get.description: For authenticated users, returns balance from auth claims. For anonymous visitors, returns remaining daily credits based on usage today.
Stream a converted file (image or video) without exposing the S3 URL.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Output format (e.g., jpg, png, mp4). If omitted, selects the default format.

get.description: Liveness probe endpoint that returns service health status with version and timestamp.
Returns the most recent media self-test results JSON for diagnostics.

post.description:
Bulk hide items (conversions and/or batches) by IDs.

POST /api/v1/media_core/visibility/hide/
Body: { "ids": ["<id1>", "<id2>", ...] }
- Marks matching ImageConversion, VideoConversion, and ConversionBatch records is_visable=False
- Returns counts of updated records
